3 fitWork rebuilt from an allocation inventory incl. Gale-returned matrices: EM step 3nh + 3ph + 6h^2 (capacitance, its factor, identity RHS, inverse, latent moment, its factor); finish = latent pass 3nh + 2h^2, d/u clones p + ph, augmented input (p+h)h, stable likelihood 2(p+h) per row (all n cumulatively, one <=64-row chunk at peak); retained model per rank; peak = fixed + all retained + largest single-rank state+transient; largest dense shape chosen by cell count among (n,p), SVD (n,k),(k,p), (p+h,h), (p+h,chunk), (h,n), (h,p). Stale SVD-era comment replaced. Test: n=4000 cumulative >= np + 2(p+h)n for ranks 1 and 2.
4 Docs: no componentwise backward-error theorem; accuracy is conditioning dependent; quadratic and diagonal evaluate transformed tail squares directly (no subtraction) and can be dominated by rounding or underflow; 1e-6 fast-diagonal floor documented as a heuristic cancellation guard, not an accuracy certificate; entries checked positive/finite else refused; observed regressions stated as fixture evidence.
5 Renamed stationarity -> diagonalMomentResidual (receipt, NotConverged field, policy diagonalMomentTolerance, helper), documented as a necessary condition over unfloored features only, not a gradient/KKT certificate; convergence explicitly not an optimality certificate.
No numerical-method change. Please bounded-delta re-review.
